svg.title: Anatomical position and reference planes
svg.desc: An upright generic adult exterior, front and right-side views. Palms face anteriorly; thumbs are lateral. Body right appears on viewer left in the front view. Dashed lines show the median sagittal plane edge-on in front, the frontal plane edge-on from the side, and one transverse plane at the abdomen.
svg.text: Anatomical position: a shared coordinate system
Generic MPFB adult exterior · official CC0 skin and fitted eyes · no internal anatomy
Gold: median sagittal (front) / frontal (side), seen edge-on.
Teal dashed: one transverse level. Lines are plane references, not incisions.
